review: Round 1 (independent, read-only): medium: the reset set 'not saving' only after awaiting the store chain, so a store arriving meanwhile could write after the delete; low-medium: the reset was offered before the saves' state was known (a second tab could delete the keeping tab's saves); low: reset failures unhandled, confirm() without releasing held keys, the hidden bar taking taps, the bar above the game's question box, no 'not kept' state, /tmp only for the canvas host (recorded), iOS pinch zoom in the margins, the runner's dialogs. Fixed. Round 2: one low-medium defect left: releaseAll() before the reset's confirm() left gamepads neutral after a cancelled dialog until a focus change; fixed (released cleared after confirm returns) and the bar and reset checks rerun on the final file (bar3). The files tested: run.html, wasi-worker.js, web_run.mjs unchanged from before the saves check to after the regression (SHA-256 checked).
